body: Null brings today's handset into the Midnight Repair Shop for Impossible Objects. Repair ticket: 'Forty-four messages sent. Forty-four returned. Still feels like no one answered.' The mechanic checks the plug: it has been connected to ECHO. She offers a new socket labeled OTHER, with a warning sticker: 'Replies not guaranteed.' Null holds the handset quietly. Tilde: 'That's how you know it works.'
